title: The Gram-normalized wedge of linearly independent vectors is a unit orientation of their span
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let a_0, …, a_{n−1} ∈ ℝ^P be linearly independent, with Gram matrix Γ := (⟨a_i, a_k⟩)_{i,k}. Then det Γ > 0, and every n-vector ξ ∈ Λ_n(ℝ^P) with ξ(α) = (det Γ)^{−1/2}·α(a_0, …, a_{n−1}) for all n-covectors α is a unit orientation of span{a_0, …, a_{n−1}}, i.e. there is an orthonormal basis τ of this span with ξ(α) = α(τ) for all α or ξ(α) = −α(τ) for all α.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → Euclid P), LinearIndependent ℝ a → 0 < Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin n => inner ℝ (a i) (a j)) ∧ ∀ ξ : MultiVector P n, (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ α = (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin n => inner ℝ (a i) (a j))))⁻¹ * α a) → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range a))
